# Iner Studio — 3D Interior Design & Modular Architecture

Iner Studio is a free, browser-based 3D interior design application built by Pixel Software Design. It allows users to design, furnish, and visualize interior spaces in real-time 3D and 360° panoramas.

## What it does

- Design rooms from scratch (width/depth/height) or import 2D floor plans and convert them to 3D
- Furnish spaces with a large built-in library: sofas, tables, beds, kitchens, bathrooms, offices, lighting, stairs, plants, outdoor furniture
- Apply realistic materials: concrete, oak, walnut, brick, glass, metal, fabric, ceramic, tile, paint
- Sculpt terrain and add nature elements (grass, shrubs, rocks, trees)
- Import 360° panoramic images and place your 3D scene inside them
- AI assistant generates rooms and furniture from natural language descriptions
- Cinematic timeline with camera keyframes for walkthrough animations
- Export projects as OBJ or GLB for use in professional 3D tools
- Save and load .pix project files
- Measure distances, boolean CSG operations, mesh editing (subdivide, extrude, bevel, smooth)
- Modifier stack, undo/redo, snap grid, quad viewport, screenshots

## For whom

- Interior designers and architects
- Homeowners visualizing renovations
- Students learning 3D design
- Anyone wanting to plan and visualize a room layout in 3D

## Tech

Web app built with Three.js, vanilla JavaScript, Cloudflare Pages. Supports WebGL rendering, real-time shadows, PBR materials, and HDR lighting.
